🌙 Raid — Ashford came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~1000 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
💬 Elif mutters: "Smile for the sky, they said. I hate how easy it was to start doing it."
Your stomach is a fist. Eat — anything real, now.
📺 The cache is up — alien ration tins, sealed, stamped with a date from before the scattering. One tin for the finding. The rest for whoever the System says the rest is for.
📺 You crack the cache for the village. Ration tins, real food, on camera. The lie on the map doesn't matter anymore — the truth in the ground does.
